condition: recombinant WT shell expressed in E. coli; 7P1T obtained from low-pH disassembly followed by neutral-pH reassembly; 8IKA is an independently determined WT shell
source: Berger et al. 2025; PDB 8IKA (Du et al., to be published)
notes: Canonical full WT T=1 shell. Berger et al. 2025 directly reported a 60-subunit T=1 icosahedron with an outer diameter of 23 nm and inner diameter of 19 nm along the fivefold axis. 7P1T was obtained from a sample subjected to pH 3 disassembly followed by neutral-pH reassembly and recovered the canonical full-shell architecture. 8IKA is an independent WT, unmutated icosahedral homo-60-mer and is grouped here because it represents the same assembly state. Wall thickness is left blank rather than calculated from outer and inner diameters. A spherical/radial wall thickness of ~2.0 nm can be calculated from the directly reported 23 nm outer and 19 nm inner diameters; this value is not directly reported.
